name: Guides
description: A collection of Guide objects in a presentation or custom layout.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of objects in the specified collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, returns an Application object that represents the PowerPoint application. When used with an object qualifier, returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return the application of that object). Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent for the specified object. Read-only Object.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a Guide object from the collection.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Orientation As PpGuideOrientation, Position As Single) As Guide
methods.description: Adds a new drawing guide to the presentation, slide master, or custom layout.
